verdicts.verify_by: build with MaxPages: len(realms)-1 and run renderBase: base.Run() returns the cap error and renderBase returns (nil, newRealms), leaving every pair without a Before
verdicts.tldr: no input the program can build queues an extra page under RenderOnly, so the cap never fires
verdicts.details: The base crawler sets RenderOnly, and inScope short-circuits on it (crawl.go:178-180 `if c.RenderOnly { return false }`), so nothing a page body links to is ever queued; only Seeds() output enters, and Seeds() dedupes through `seen` and emits exactly one URL per realm. Run tests `visited[u]` (crawl.go:122) before the cap (crawl.go:126), so a seed re-queued from a link is dropped before it is counted. With N seeds and MaxPages N, iteration k sees at most k-1 pages, so `len(c.pages) >= c.MaxPages` never holds. The headroom really is zero, which is the latent point worth stating, but the silent loss of every before/after needs a code change first. Fix: none required; `MaxPages: len(realms) + 4` would make the invariant explicit rather than incidental.
verdicts.evidence: read, head worktree: crawl.go:178-180 (RenderOnly makes inScope false); crawl.go:76-90 (Seeds dedupes via `seen`, `if c.RenderOnly { continue }` before the $source/$help adds); crawl.go:119-128 (visited check precedes the cap check).

verdicts.verify_by: fmt.Errorf("x: %w", error(nil)) in a scratch main: expect a usable message, observe "x: %!w(<nil>)"
verdicts.tldr: a gnodev that exits cleanly reports a format-verb error where the reason should be
verdicts.details: startGnodev sends cmd.Wait() down the died channel (main.go:202), and Wait returns nil on exit status 0 -- a flag gnodev rejects cleanly, a subcommand that prints usage and returns. waitReady wraps that nil with %w, and Go renders it as the verb error. The channel was added so a gnodev that dies on startup says why; the clean-exit case is the one where it says nothing usable. Fix: branch on a nil err and report the clean exit, or wrap with %v.

verdicts.verify_by: read crawl.go:41 and 359-362: the regex captures the quote as optional and the replacement never re-emits it
verdicts.tldr: a rewritten asset path that needs quoting comes back as an invalid CSS url token
verdicts.details: cssRe matches an optional quote and the replacement always emits a bare url(...), so quoting the source had is lost; a path carrying a space or a paren then yields a token the browser rejects and the declaration is dropped with no error. Reachability at this head is narrow: the shipped gnoweb stylesheets write relative refs (`url(fonts/intervar/Intervar.woff2)`) that cssRe never matches, and no file under gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/public carries a space or a paren, so the bite needs an inline /public/ url() plus such a name. Fix: emit `"url(\"" + up + path + "\")"`.
verdicts.evidence: go1.25.9, TestJudgeCSSReDropsQuotes: in `background:url("/public/fonts/My Font.woff2")` -> out `background:url(../public/fonts/My Font.woff2)`. Read: crawl.go:41 `url\(\s*"?(/public/[^)"']*)"?\s*\)`; crawl.go:361 `return "url(" + up + strings.TrimPrefix(sub[1], "/") + ")"`. grep of gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/public/*.css: three url() refs, all relative; find over that tree for a name with a space or paren: no hit.

verdicts.verify_by: regexp `(?i)<head[^>]*>` against `<header class="b-header">`: expect no match, observe a match on `<header class="b-header">`
verdicts.tldr: on a page with no <head>, the noindex meta is planted inside <header> where no crawler reads it
verdicts.details: setNoindex reaches headRe only when the page carries no robots meta (crawl.go:371-376), which is the case crawl_test.go:175 defends -- a body gnoweb serves without a head. gnoweb's own layout ships `<header class="b-header">` on every page, so on such a body the tag is inserted inside the header element rather than the document head, and the snapshot is indexable in practice while the test still passes, since it only counts the tag. A full page is unaffected: the real <head> precedes <header> and FindStringIndex takes the first match. Fix: `(?i)<head[\s>]`.

The collision the comment guards against does not occur either way, since the two passes name different ports. Fix: resolve cfg.out with filepath.Abs once at startup. verdicts.verify_by: read comment.go:169-176 against crawl.go:75-105 and 130-146: the guard reads c.pages[u] only, while the row emits three hrefs derived from u, u+$source and u+$help
verdicts.tldr: the index links source and help pages it never checked were captured
verdicts.details: Seeds queues the render, $source and $help URLs of each realm as three independent pages, and Run drops any one of them on a transport error or a non-200 with a stderr line and a continue. Index guards on the render page alone and then writes all three hrefs, so a reader of the published snapshot clicks a 404 on a link sitting beside one that was checked. The candidate's second half does not hold: urlOf(r) carries neither ':' nor '$', so canonicalURL is the identity on it and the raw key reads the same entry as FileOf would. Fix: look each of the three up in c.pages and emit only what is present.
